motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: House ease (--ease): buttons 150ms, cards 200ms, sticky bar 280ms, tug bar 600ms.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The arena ease-out: digit ignite, lamp bloom, and every stage of the champion reveal.

motion.name: ignite
motion.purpose: A changed digit flares from sun with a glow in its own cell.

motion.name: lamp-ignite
motion.purpose: A lit lamp blooms a sun ring outward once.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Chips, round tabs and share buttons on :active; buttons drop 1px instead.

motion.name: champion-reveal
motion.value: settle 900ms; crown-drop 800ms after 450ms; name 700ms after 750ms; all cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Photo settles from rotate(-7deg) scale(0.92), crown drops 36px from -30deg, name rises 14px out of a 3px blur.

motion.name: confetti-fall
motion.purpose: Paper falls behind the champion (ON_SUN colors) and on a credited thank-you screen.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses everything, including the champion reveal; confetti is not rendered.

touch.name: hover-gate
touch.purpose: Wraps every :hover rule in app.css and widget.css.

touch.name: tap
touch.purpose: No tap flash, no double-tap wait, on links and controls.

touch.name: select
touch.purpose: Controls only (buttons, chips, tabs, share buttons, ARIA buttons and tabs).

touch.name: safe-area

touch.name: admin-coarse-inputs

narrative.northStar: Follow the Money, in Arena Mode
narrative.overview:
The site is WPR's newsroom system, the one it uses to follow the money, carried into a sports arena. The ground stays a newsroom's: warm cream paper, a slate-ruled masthead, Public Sans body copy, Fraunces headlines. On that ground the contest lays out an arena: a deep-teal scoreboard with fixed-cell digits, a lamp that lights when something happens, a game clock, and a road of dots running from the open round to a crown. The newsroom supplies the credibility; the arena supplies the stakes.

Density is set for one iPhone screen. The pet page puts the pet, its place on the road, the live game and the Vote button inside a 390 by 844 viewport; Home puts its title, the live board for the current phase and the primary action there too. The shell gives up height to make room: a one-line masthead on phones, a slim one-line contest bar, then the nav. Drama is staged and never faked. Digits change in place and nothing reflows. On the board the lamp is always present, lit or unlit, so an upset reads as a light coming on, not a badge appearing. Wherever a count appears, it is labeled as resetting every round.

Sun yellow is held back for the moments that count: a lit lamp, the leader's tug bar and ring, the crown, Double Vote windows, and one whole field, the champion's. Teal does the structural work. Shadows are soft and tinted with teal; there are no hard offsets.
keyCharacteristics: Cream newsroom ground with one deep-teal arena panel per screen.
JetBrains Mono digits in dark fixed cells over ghost 8s; tabular figures everywhere a number is counted.
Fraunces at optical size 144 for pet names and big lines, set over the photo behind a teal scrim.
The road: teal dots, solid where the pet has traveled and dashed ahead, ending in a drawn crown.
Pill-shaped controls with soft, teal-tinted drop shadows.
Drawn SVG marks for arrows, checks, crosses and the crown; never text glyphs.
One sun field in the whole contest: the champion's.

rules.name: The Fill-Versus-Ink Rule
rules.body: Teal and sun are fills. Text in either family uses its ink partner (teal-ink, sun-ink) on light grounds. Sun can be text only on teal-deep.

rules.name: The Sun Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Sun appears where something is won, leading, lit or doubled. A sun surface that marks nothing is noise.

rules.name: The One Sun Field Rule
rules.body: The champion panel is the only panel filled with sun. Everywhere else sun is a ring, a bar, a lamp, a pill or a crown.

rules.name: The White-Label Line
rules.body: The teal family, the sun family, cream and the three font faces belong to this brand; another newsroom would swap them. Ink, ink-2, muted, paper, rule, rule-strong and red are role-like and carry over unchanged. Slate and the masthead belong to WPR's identity, not the contest's. The board shades are derived from teal-deep and would have to move with it.

rules.name: The Counted-In-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any number a reader might compare (votes, seeds, ranks, prices per vote, clocks) sets in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Dollar headline amounts set in Fraunces at opsz 144.

rules.name: The Big-Line Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Fraunces lines larger than about 30px use `'opsz' 144` with the display fallback face; smaller Fraunces stays at the default optical size with the regular fallback.

rules.name: The Under-Never-Over Rule
rules.body: A count or status sits under its heading, never above it as a kicker. Headings carry no kicker at all. A section count goes beneath the heading, and only when it says something the heading doesn't. The scoreboard's round name is the board's header row, not a kicker over a heading.

rules.name: The Soft-Offset Rule
rules.body: Buttons sit on a soft, tinted shadow with a negative spread. Pressing them moves them down 1px and tightens the shadow. Hard offsets are not part of this world.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: On the board, emphasis is light, not elevation: a sun ring on the leader's face or row, a lamp igniting, a digit flaring sun as it changes.

dos: Do put the pet, its road, the live board and a working Vote button inside a 390 by 844 first viewport.
Do put Home's title, the phase board and the primary action above the fold at 390 by 844.
Do set every comparable number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, and change digits in place inside fixed cells.
Do say "Totals reset every round" wherever a count appears.
Do use teal-ink, never teal, for text and button fills on light grounds; reserve sun for lit, leading, won or doubled.
Do draw arrows, checks, crosses and the crown as inline SVG that rides the text baseline.
Do give buttons the soft, tinted press shadow and a 1px press.
Do keep sponsor placements visually lighter than Vote, and keep them off the buyer's thank-you screen.
Do keep the lamp present on the board while unlit, so its moment is a light igniting.
Do honor reduced motion: ignite, lamp bloom, the champion reveal, confetti and transitions all collapse.
Do gate every hover style behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and give touch an `:active` press instead.
Do pad page edges with `--pad-l` and `--pad-r` so content clears the notch.
donts: Don't place an uppercase kicker or eyebrow above a heading; put counts and status beneath it.
Don't use text glyphs for arrows, checks or crosses.
Don't set body text in teal or sun on cream.
Don't call a vote pack a donation.
Don't pin a fixed Vote bar inside the WordPress iframe.
Don't let a count reflow or slide when it changes.
Don't fill any panel but the champion's with sun.
Don't truncate a name on the bracket poster or inside a Vote button; let it wrap.
